title: IOVNBDPhase0ManifestRecord
description: Per-file manifest schema for IO-VNBD dataset discovery (Phase 0).

filename.description: Base filename of the raw CSV recording.

prefix.description: File prefix indicating data source (S- for smartphone, V- for vehicle CAN/VBOX).

driver_id.description: Identifier of the driver (e.g. D1, D2).

vehicle_id.description: Identifier of the vehicle (e.g. V1, V2).

country.description: Country where the recording was collected (UK, France, Nigeria).

row_count.description: Total number of data rows excluding headers.

measured_rate_hz.description: Empirically measured sampling rate computed as 1 / median(diff(timestamps)).

has_v_pair.description: Whether an S- file has a corresponding V- file pair in Synchronised V and S.

stationary_segments_present.description: Whether one or more candidate stationary segments are detected.

outage_index_present.description: Whether the recording intersects a documented GPS outage window in the outage index.
